olivia: Heads-up — customer acme-pay (ticket #34521) reporting intermittent structured-output parse failures in prod since 2026-03-06. They use strict JSON mode and started seeing InvalidType errors: "expected number got string" for charge ids. Request id: req_abc123. Also they noticed some boolean fields missing (is_verified) and enum casing mismatches ("Active" vs "ACTIVE"). latency spike around 14:02 UTC reported as well. Can we reproduce and advise?

sarah: can you paste the raw API response + a curl repro? also which model/version?

olivia: repro curl below (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2.1-large","mode":"structured_json","schema":{"charges":[{"id":"number","is_verified":"boolean","status":{"type":"string","enum":["ACTIVE","PENDING"]}}]},"input":{"invoice_id":123}}'
```
Sample response we got back (body trimmed):
```json
{"charges":[{"id":"123456789","amount":1250,"status":"Active"}],"meta":{}}
```
Note: `id` is quoted (string), `is_verified` omitted entirely, and `status` is "Active" not "ACTIVE" — strict parser fails.

john_d: thanks — two separate failure modes here: quoted numeric id (type mismatch) and enum casing + missing boolean (null/omission). Which model_revision? any recent packaging changes?

olivia: model_revision: 2026-03-01-rc, seen on hosted and their dedicated pool (customer-ded-34). Error reproduced for req_abc123 and req_def456. Repro isn't 100% — happens ~60% of calls.

mike_ops: I pulled the serve logs for req_abc123. The model emitted a stringified id token sequence. Our output-formatter plugin `safe-json` was enabled in that revision — it was rolled out 2026-03-05 02:10 UTC to reduce JS int loss by quoting large integers. Looks like it quotes all numeric-looking ids, not just >2^53. Also there's a downstream flattener that drops null/undefined optional fields leading to the missing boolean.

repro-bot: automated repro run (10 requests against redwood-v2.1-large @ 2026-03-07T15:00Z):
- strict_json parse: 6 failures, 4 successes
- non-strict parse: 10 successes
Attached sample failures: InvalidType at /charges/0/id expected number got string; MissingField at /charges/0/is_verified optional but absent (null expected).

john_d: we did flip serializer behavior to `preserve_js_int` on 2026-03-05 to avoid precision loss for some billing customers — that change caused quoting of numeric tokens. We missed adding a compatibility flag for strict-json parser consumers. Patch plan: add a per-request flag `accept_string_numbers` and a server-side coercion path that will convert numeric-looking strings to numbers before the strict schema check. Also add a toggle to avoid dropping nulls in the post-processor.

olivia: customer needs immediate mitigation — their downstream consumer fails the schema and blocks processing. Can we route this customer's traffic to the previous serializer until patch is live?

mike_ops: starting rollback for model_revision on customer-ded-34 and a routing override for acme-pay. Triggering hotfix rollout now — estimated ~30m. Adding alert: structured-parse-errors > 10/min for any org triggers paging.

john_d: I'll open ENG-RUNTIME ticket (ENG-rt-4623) and assign to eng-runtime team. Short-term steps:
- implement `accept_string_numbers` (server-side coercion)
- add config to keep nulls for optional fields
- add enum normalization helper (case-insensitive match) behind a flag
Long-term: add explicit compatibility notes to structured-output doc about quoted-id behavior.

olivia: I'll update the customer with the rollback and ETA. Also asking them to try non-strict lenient mode as a temporary workaround if they can accept stringified ids.

sarah: thanks — let me know once rollback + hotfix are confirmed. I'll mark the ticket P1 until resolved. :white_check_mark:
